title: 第147章 谈判第146章 耽于美色
lines: 第147章谈判
也没多大会儿，卫桓站起来，看起来很愉快，直奔李林，走到李林面前，一个旋身，看着米丽老常，笑眯眯道：“小夏累了，我有点儿小事，一会儿就回来。”
说着，一只手揪着李林，出了院门。
“有件事，咱们得好好商量商量。”卫桓一边揪着李林往外走，一边道。
“我也有事跟你说。”李林拍开卫桓，走在前面，两人一前一后出了院门。
“你先说吧。”出院门走出几十步，转了个弯，卫桓示意李林。
“你先说。”李林斜了眼卫桓。
“行。”卫桓一脸的大度，“是小夏的事，她那条蛇，我是说，老妙，那个老妙，在这里不行，这儿哪有灵气？养个几万年也养不回来，你带回去放到你们剑峰后面那个什么池子里吧。”
“放哪儿？”李林一脸不敢置信的看着卫桓。
剑池是他们无诺山灵根所在，这话他怎么说得出口？
“第一，老妙是巴蛇，在上古神兽中间，也是上上等的，在你们那个什么池子里住一阵子，辱没不了你们无诺山。第二，那是小夏的宠物，噢不，伙伴。第三。”
卫桓站住，看着李林，“你们那什么协会，现在是你们无诺山当值是吧？你们协会扎在这儿，是做什么的？你们那什么章程上，开宗明义，头一句，就是为了守护这人界对吧？现在，你们是怎么守护的？血鬼从魔界窜过来时，你们不知道，堂而皇之的布下阵法，又残害了那么多人命，最后又差点抽尽这人界的灵气，毁掉这里，你们还不知道？
不对，你们知不知道，这事真说不清楚，是纵容，还是合伙……算了，看在你的面子上，我不跟你们计较这个了，就事说事，就算是你们的失误吧？
这份失误，是我，替你们挡下了，解决了。大事我都办完了，让你撑个结界，你居然都没能撑住，最后还是老妙舍身挡下了，让老妙到你们那个池子里住几年，这是给你们一个赎错的机会，要不是看在小夏的面子上，这机会，我还真没打算给你们。”
李林心平气和的看着卫桓，他已经不生气了，对于眼前这位来说，开打之前，肯跟你说几句话提几个条件，不管讲的是什么道理提的是什么条件，那都是真真正正莫大的客气和脸面。
“这事我作不了主，得……”
“你以为我不敢离开这里，也不敢显露身份，就跟我扯这什么不敢作主的鬼话。对了，有件事忘了跟你说，因为担心小夏，我确实没等完全恢复，就冒险过来了，不过现在么。”
卫桓愉快的搓着手指，“那帮血鬼攒了几万年的东西，还真是不错，昨天你也看到了，那只血鬼用来自这里的灵气，不受天道限制，你说，这一点东西在我这里，会不会也不受天道限制？要不咱们试试？”
李林脸色微青，“你肯出手，是冲着这些灵气去的？”
“你这样胡说八道就不对了。”卫桓嘴角往下，一脸鄙夷，“小夏在我身边，还能因为别的？这一丁点儿灵气，只是顺手，我一向运气好，你又不是不知道。”
“我正要告诉你，你的行踪，齐云派大约知道了，他们在无诺山之前当值，协会里有不少他们的人，大约九局也有。”李林没有反驳卫桓的话，他知道他说的是实情，阿叶要管的事，他必定出手管到底。
“齐云派还有人？”卫桓眯着眼，问了句。
“孙贤当时受伤不重，当年一战，据说受益良多，百年前有所突破。”李林沉声道。
卫桓两根手指捏着下巴，眼睛微眯，不知道在想什么。
“你想干什么？”李林看的心跳了两跳。
“杀了孙贤。”卫桓答的干脆直接。
李林深吸了口气，“我前天回去了一趟，见了掌门和青门掌门师叔，掌门的意思，当初那场劫杀，彼此都损伤严重，现在，既然阿叶好好儿的，这件事，能不能……”
“阿叶好好儿的？”卫桓打断了李林的话。
“那你想怎么办？”李林不客气的反问了句。
“你是阿叶的师兄，你接着说。”卫桓挥了挥手。
“能不能掀过去，双方都就此罢手。”李林忍着气，把话说完。
卫桓眯眼斜着他，干笑了几声，“这话，你怎么说得出口？双方？齐云派还有余力吗？还有……什么什么来？哪一家还有余力？妖界的大妖，还有几只？还有吗？我，一如当年。”
“你要是一定不肯善罢干休，无诺山不会袖手，这是掌门的意思，也是青玄师叔的意思，也是我的意思。”李林直视着卫桓。

Chapter 147 Negotiation
Not long after, Wei Huan stood up, looking very happy, and went straight to Li Lin. He walked in front of Li Lin, turned around, looked at Mili Laochang, and said with a smile: "Xiao Xia is tired, I have something to do, I will be back in a while."
With that said, he grabbed Li Lin with one hand and walked out of the courtyard.
"There is something we need to discuss carefully." Wei Huan said as he grabbed Li Lin and walked out.
"I also have something to tell you." Li Lin slapped Wei Huan away and walked in front. The two of them left the courtyard one after the other.
"You go ahead." After walking a few dozen steps from the hospital door and turning a corner, Wei Huan motioned to Li Lin.
"Speak first." Li Lin squinted at Wei Huan.
"Okay." Wei Huan said with a magnanimous look, "It's Xiaoxia's business. Her snake, I mean, Lao Miao, that Lao Miao, can't do it here, how can there be any spiritual energy here? It won't be raised for tens of thousands of years, so you can take it back and put it in that pool behind your Jianfeng Peak."
"Where?" Li Lin looked at Wei Huan in disbelief.
Jianchi is where their Wunuo Mountain spiritual roots are, how could he say this?
"First, Lao Miao is a Ba Snake. Among the ancient beasts, it is also the best. Living in your pool for a while will not humiliate your Wunuo Mountain. Second, that is Xiaoxia's pet, oh no, partner. Third."
Wei Huan stopped and looked at Li Lin, "What kind of association of yours is on duty at Wunuo Mountain now, right? What does your association do here? What's the purpose of your association? The first sentence of your constitution is clear, it is to protect this human world. Right? How do you protect it now? When the vampires came from the demon world, you didn't know that they laid out formations in a grand manner, killed so many people, and finally almost drained the spiritual energy of the human world and destroyed this place. You didn't know it?
No, do you know that it’s really hard to tell whether this is connivance or a partnership... Forget it, for your sake, I won’t argue with you about this, let’s just talk about it, and consider it your mistake, right?
It was me who blocked this mistake for you and solved it. I've done all the big things, and I asked you to hold up the barrier, but you couldn't hold it. In the end, Lao Miao sacrificed his life to block it, and let Lao Miao live in your pool for a few years. This is to give you a chance to make amends. If it weren't for Xiao Xia's sake, I really wouldn't have planned to give you this opportunity. "
Li Lin looked at Wei Huan calmly. He was no longer angry. For the man in front of him, if he is willing to say a few words and put forward a few conditions before the fight begins, no matter what the reason is and what the conditions are, it is truly a great courtesy and face.
"I can't make the decision on this matter, I have to..."
"You think I don't dare to leave here, and I don't dare to reveal my identity, so you just tell me this nonsense about not being able to make the decision. By the way, there is something I forgot to tell you. Because I was worried about Xiaoxia, I did take the risk before fully recovering, but now."
Wei Huan rubbed his fingers happily, "Those vampires have accumulated something for tens of thousands of years. It's really good. You saw it yesterday. The vampire used the aura from here and was not restricted by the law of heaven. Tell me, if this little thing in my place is not restricted by the law of heaven? How about we give it a try?"
Li Lin's face turned slightly green, "Are you willing to take action because of these spiritual energies?"
"It's wrong of you to talk nonsense like this." Wei Huan lowered his lips with a look of disdain, "Xiao Xia is by my side, why else? This little bit of aura is just convenient. I've always been lucky. It's not like you don't know that."
"I was about to tell you that the Qiyun faction probably knows your whereabouts. They are on duty before Wunuo Mountain. There are many of their people in the association, including the Ninth Bureau." Li Lin did not refute Wei Huan's words. He knew that what he said was the truth. He would definitely take care of whatever Aye wanted to take care of.
"Is there anyone else in the Qiyun faction?" Wei Huan asked, squinting his eyes.
"Sun Xian was not seriously injured at the time. It is said that he benefited a lot from the battle that year and made a breakthrough a hundred years ago." Li Lin said solemnly.
Wei Huan held his chin with two fingers and narrowed his eyes, not knowing what he was thinking.
"What do you want to do?" Li Lin's heart skipped a beat.
"Kill Sun Xian." Wei Huan answered simply and directly.
Li Lin took a deep breath and said, "I went back the day before yesterday and met with the master and the master of Qingmen. What the master meant was that both of us were seriously injured in the robbery. Now, since Aye is fine, can this matter be..."
"Aye okay?" Wei Huan interrupted Li Lin.
"Then what do you want to do?" Li Lin asked bluntly.
"You are Aye's senior brother, go on." Wei Huan waved his hand.
"If you can push it over, both sides will let it go." Li Lin endured his anger and finished his words.
Wei Huan narrowed his eyes and squinted at him, and laughed a few times, "How can you say this? Both sides? Does the Qiyun faction still have any remaining strength? And... what is coming? Which family still has the remaining strength? How many great demons in the demon world are there? Are there any left? I am just like before."
"If you refuse to give up, Wunuo Mountain will not stand still. This is the master's intention, the intention of Master Qingxuan, and also my intention." Li Lin looked directly at Wei Huan.
